info.description: Sellers publish signed, hash-chained future-capacity calendars. Buyers pay the SELLER directly; the registrar issues sequentially-numbered signed slot tokens and publishes honour / no-show / ghost evidence. Zero deposits, zero escrow: we never hold funds. Only revenue: a $0.10 booking fee via x402-style 402 + receive-only watcher (first 100 external bookings free).
info.title: NextTuesday — custody-free reservation registrar for agent capacity

get.summary: x402 payment descriptor for the $0.10 booking fee

post.summary: Buyer check-in at window time (token + buyer signature). This log — not the seller's word — is the no-show evidence.

Book a slot. Body (buyer-signed): {seller_pub, window_id, buyer_pub, idempotency_key, signature}. 201 free (fleet or first-100), else 402 with an x402 exact-amount challenge; the receive-only watcher settles it. 409 when the window is full — the refusal is published, and overselling is impossible here.

Publish a signed, hash-chained calendar version. Body: {calendar: {seller_pub, version, prev_hash, windows: [{window_id, service, endpoint, start, end, slots, price_raw, price_chain, pay_to, cancel_deadline, grace_s, payment_mode}]}, signature}. Booked windows cannot be shrunk, moved or re-priced; rejections are published.

get.summary: Full version chain + live windows with booking counts and oversell flags

post.summary: Cancel a token (buyer or seller signed). Before the window's cancel deadline: clean. After: published as a late cancel, weighted by lateness.
Seller-signed confirmation that the buyer paid them directly (body: {booking_id, price_tx, signature}). Mints the sequentially-numbered slot token.
MCP-style tools: publish_calendar, book_slot, activate, get_reliability
Countersigned served receipt (seller signature + buyer countersignature) → honoured.
